field.name: demo
field.help: If enabled, Rewards Codes will run in demo mode with sample data.

field.name: phone
field.help: Phone number used to create your account at https://partner.rewards.codes. Must include the country code, e.g. +52XXXXXXXXXX.

field.name: api_key
field.help: Your developer key located at the bottom of the Settings page in https://partner.rewards.codes.

field.name: default_phone_code
field.help: The country code used for customer numbers. Example: +52 or +1.

field.name: qr
field.help: Enable this option to print a Rewards Codes QR on customer receipts or tickets.

field.name: mode
field.help: Select the type of rewards: Visits, Products or E-Money.

field.name: emoney_percent
field.help: Percentage of the purchase amount returned as electronic money to the customer.

field.p: A Rewards Codes configuration allows you to reward your customers.
